bibl.title: Tattvamasyakhaṇḍārthanirūpaṇa
bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
A Triennial Catalogue of Manuscripts, GOML, Vol. IV, Part I, Sanskrit A.

V. Raghavan writes that the author of this work seems to be identical with the author of the Siddhāntacandrikā, i.e., Rāmānanda. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 33–34.
This work is a criticism of the Viśiṣṭādvaita and Dvaita interpretations of tat tvam asi.
